key.name: pointer-style
key.summary: Hand style id, or 'laser' for the laser dot

key.name: pinned-styles
key.summary: Styles shown directly on the toolbar

key.name: pointer-size
key.summary: Hand length as a fraction of the screen height

key.name: show-shadow
key.summary: Draw a soft shadow under the hand

key.name: fade-seconds
key.summary: Seconds before a drawing fades away; 0 keeps drawings until cleared

key.name: ink-choice
key.summary: Ink colour id, or 'match' to follow the hand

key.name: draw-shape
key.summary: What dragging draws: pen, ellipse, rectangle or arrow

key.name: tap-sound
key.summary: Tap sound: thock, click, pop, wood, boop or squeak

key.name: hand-sound
key.summary: Play the tap sound with hands

key.name: laser-sound
key.summary: Play the tap sound with the laser dot

key.name: interact-key
key.summary: Modifier that lets clicks reach apps while held: alt, super, ctrl or off

key.name: toggle-pointer
key.summary: Turn the pointer on or off

key.name: exit-pointer
key.summary: Clear everything and turn the pointer off (only bound while the pointer is on)

key.name: hint-shown
key.summary: Whether the first-run hint was shown
